# recurrence rule text

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/recurrenceRuleText>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The recurrence rule as an RFC 5545 RRULE string (e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO). Projected directly to iCalendar RRULE; a SET-typed TIMEX3 in ISO-TimeML.
